label: OSPFv3
notes: OSPF for IPv6 (RFC 5340 §A.3.1) over IPv6 next-header 89. The 16-byte header is modelled in full. The Router Id and Area Id are payload-embedded 4-byte identifiers — not IPv6 addresses, but shaped like the OSPFv2 ones, and unreachable by host primitives, so they are first-class ipv4 fields. The checksum is the standard upper-layer checksum over the IPv6 pseudo-header (RFC 5340 §A.3.1). The Instance Id multiplexes independent OSPFv3 protocol instances (address families per RFC 5838) on the same link; 0 is the base IPv6 unicast instance. The message body (hello parameters, LSAs, DBD contents) follows with variable length.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Packet type, same five as OSPFv2.

fields.label: Packet Length
fields.description: Length of the OSPF packet including this header, in bytes.

fields.label: Area Id
fields.description: The OSPF area this packet belongs to; 0.0.0.0 is the backbone.

fields.label: Checksum
fields.description: Standard upper-layer checksum over the IPv6 pseudo-header.

fields.label: Instance Id
fields.description: Multiplexes independent OSPFv3 instances on a link (RFC 5838 address families); 0 for the base instance.
